verdicts.quote: The first time reminders are turned on, the proposed schedule is -3, 0, 3, 7, 14, 30.
The invoice is paid in full, voided, written off or fully credited (by the customer online, by the business recording a bank transfer, or by a credit note). No further reminder is sent for it
verdicts.missing: Disputed invoices and payment plans are not stop conditions; a dispute is handled only by a member pausing the invoice by hand (U-5), and payment plans are not mentioned anywhere.

verdicts.quote: Total 1,250.00 USD with 500.00 paid: the reminder states 750.00 USD outstanding and 1,250.00 USD total.
Any email suppression or do-not-email preference the host product already holds for an address or customer is honoured: such a customer is treated as excluded (C-74)
verdicts.missing: Whether a marketing-only opt-out also blocks billing reminders, or whether billing notices are exempt from it.

verdicts.quote: Across restarts, retries, duplicated scheduler runs and several servers running at once, the customer receives one email for invoice 1042, step +7, due date 2027-03-12, never two.
Just before a reminder is handed to the email provider, the invoice's current state and balance are checked, and nothing is sent if the invoice is no longer eligible.

A temporary failure ... is retried up to 3 times, each at least 10 minutes after the last attempt ... An alert reaches the operators within 5 minutes ... when more than 10% of at least 20 reminders ... failed.
When the email provider's own sending rate limit is reached, reminders wait as Queued and are handed over as the limit allows; they are not dropped and not counted as failures.
Open invoices that are not yet overdue get their remaining scheduled reminders; invoices already past one or more steps do not receive those past steps in a burst.
The send hour is a whole hour 0 to 23 in the workspace timezone, default 9.
verdicts.missing: Timing follows the workspace's timezone, not the customer's local time, and the spec says nothing about weekends or holidays.

verdicts.quote: "1,250.00 USD" (or an equally unambiguous amount-plus-currency form)
verdicts.missing: The exact amount format (decimal places, separators, symbol versus code) and whether it follows the recipient's locale are left open.

verdicts.quote: An address that produced a hard bounce, a permanent rejection at handover or a spam complaint is suppressed ... If an invoice has no recipient address, its due steps are recorded as Skipped with reason "no recipient"
A reminder is addressed to the invoice's billing email addresses, at most five, and if the invoice has none, to the customer's primary email address.
Each invoice shows its reminder history ... A reminder entry shows the date and time, its kind (a scheduled step with its offset, or Manual ...), the recipients ... and the outcome
the invoice number, the customer name, the outstanding balance with its currency, the due date ... a link to the invoice page ... keep working for as long as the invoice's history is kept
Only Admins can change the workspace's reminder settings ... A Member can pause, resume and send reminders for an invoice and switch a customer's exclusion; a Viewer cannot.
Turning reminders off stops ... switch "Do not send reminders" on or off for a customer ... An Admin can send a test reminder ... can send a reminder now for one invoice.
Scheduled (with the date and time of the next reminder) ... it matches what the system will do next ... Filtering by outcome Failed shows only Failed entries
at most 5,000 scheduled reminder emails ... per calendar day ... A step that is late is still sent if it is no more than 48 hours past its scheduled moment
Reminders never block, delay or fail recording a payment, voiding, editing or issuing an invoice. ... Reminders never change an invoice's state, amounts, due date, billing emails or customer.
